I'll say it again. You must meet the Champions and receive their power.
strings.이리스의 힘이 완전해져야 한다면서… 왜 초인의 힘이 필요한 거죠?: You said Iris needs to complete her own power... Why does she need the Champions' power?
strings.이리스 님이 신이 되시긴 했지만, 지금 지닌 힘은 초인이라 불리는 이들보: Iris may have become a god, but her current power falls far short of those we call Champions.
strings.초인과 같거나 초인보다 높은 힘의 반열에 올라야 하는데, 지금 이리스 님: She needs to reach a level of power equal to theirs, or greater. With her current abilities, that seems impossible.
Iris will face and cut down her fear and dread in the Training Forest...
strings.모험가님께선 직접 초인들을 만나 그들이 가진 힘의 일부를 가져오셔야 합니: While you must meet the Champions in person and bring back a portion of their power.
How am I supposed to bring back power? That's awfully vague.
strings.그건 크게 걱정하실 필요는 없습니다. 어떤 형태로든지 그들에게 받아올 수: You needn't worry too much about that. There must be a way to receive it from them, in one form or another.
strings.이런 중요한 일인데, 이리스가 직접 가야 하는 거 아닌가요?: If it's this important, shouldn't Iris go herself?
strings.그것도 가능합니다만, 아직 불안한 상태의 이리스 님이 외부에 노출된다면: She could. But what do you think would happen if Iris were exposed to the outside world in her current unstable condition?
strings.그분이 가진 권능을 노리는 이들은 한둘이 아닙니다. 섣불리 움직였다가 어: There are many who covet her divine authority. No one knows what catastrophe might follow if she acts rashly.
And there is another problem. 'That world' is coming back.
strings.쥬얼 학파 마법사들이 보고한 바로는 '그 세계'가 진로를 바꿔 이곳으로: According to the Jewel School mages, 'that world' has changed course and is heading back here.
strings.데미갓 벨로쉬가 바이스와의 전투에서 신성력을 봉인 당했다고, 저 멀리 날: Just because the demigod Belosh had his divine power sealed in his battle with Weiss, a world sent so far away is coming back...
strings.애초에 말이 되지 않습니다. 위대하다면 위대할 수도 있는 신의 힘으로 만: The whole thing was absurd from the start. A world created by the power of a god, however great that god may be! How could a mere demigod possibly have dealt with it?!
I'm sorry. I lost my composure for a moment... That was rude of me.
strings.아니예요, 괜찮아요. 그래서 남은 시간은 얼마나 될까요?: No, it's all right. So how much time do we have left?
If Iris grows stronger than the Champions and becomes a true god...
strings.모든 게 해결됩니다. 신의 힘을 노리는 악마들도, 나쁜 짓을 할 수밖에: Everything will be resolved. The demons seeking divine power, the Agasuras who cannot help committing evil, even the Deimos cult...
strings.부탁드립니다. 모험가님은 서둘러 위대한 정령들에게서 지혜를 얻어 방법을: Please. Seek the great spirits at once, and learn what to do from their wisdom. They should be more helpful than I am.
I suppose I'd better. Sigh... All right, I'm off.
strings.(아직 심상세계로 가는 길이 남아있으니 서둘러 가보자.): (The path to the inner world is still open. I'd better hurry.)
strings.(유란이 뒤에서 인기척을 느끼고 뒤돌아본다. 정의롭고 인자해 보이는 중년: (Yuran senses someone behind her and turns around. A middle-aged man with a kindly, upright bearing is watching her.)
strings.(연합 본부 안에 있던 사람들이 모두 중년 남성을 향해 지스카드 혹은 맹: (Everyone in the Alliance Headquarters respectfully greets the middle-aged man, addressing him as Ziskad or Alliance Leader.)
Thank you for handling matters so well while I was away.
Not at all. I was only doing what I had to do.
The one who just passed by was that person, then.
Yes. The errand-runner for Iris I told you about...
strings.너는 저 사람을 어떻게 생각하느냐?: What do you think of that person?
strings.이야기가 길어질 것 같습니다만, 괜찮으시겠습니까?: It's a long story. Do you have the time?
I do. Let us go somewhere else, and I'll hear it.
Welcome, adventurer. We meet again so soon.
strings.무슨 일로 오셨을지 알 것 같아요. 제가 맞춰볼까요?: I think I know why you've come. Shall I guess?
strings.어, 제가 말을 하지 않았는데 어떻게 아세요?: Huh? How do you know? I haven't said anything yet.
strings.제가 비록 여신님의 심상세계 안에 있지만, 여신님과 관계된 이야기가 여신: Though I'm inside the goddess's inner world, I naturally become aware of conversations concerning her when they take place nearby.
Since the goddess is in Lumen, I can learn something of what's happening there, even if not every detail.
Then I'd better not say anything bad about you, Harmonia. If you hear all of it...
strings.어, 제가 뭔가 잘못이라도 했나요?: Oh... Have I done something wrong?
The goddess's current power is sorely lacking.
strings.안정되지 않은 능력에 힘을 실어주려면, 안정된 힘으로 능력을 사용하는 자: To strengthen her unstable abilities, she needs help from those who wield their power with stability.
strings.인간이지만 신에 가까운 능력을 갖춘 자들. 그들이 인정한다면 그 힘의 일: Humans with abilities close to those of gods. If they acknowledge you, you may be able to bring back traces of their power.
strings.그 흔적이 물건이라면 제가 가져다 이리스에게 줄 수도 있지만, 그게 아니: If those traces are objects, I can bring them to Iris. But what if they aren't?
You simply need to receive their power.
strings.네? 그대로 받다뇨? 설마 힘이라는 게 슝~ 하고 전송이라도 되는 건가요: Huh? Just receive it? Don't tell me the power goes whoosh and gets transmitted to her?
strings.비슷해요. 여신님께서 모험가님께 꿈의 길을 보여주신 것처럼…. 이미 정신: Something like that. Just as the goddess showed you the path of dreams... part of your minds is already connected.
She's not seeing too much, is she? That sounds like an invasion of privacy...
strings.…너무 심각하게 생각하진 마세요. 그냥 정신적 교감 정도로만 인식하는 게: ...Don't take it too seriously. It's easier to think of it as a spiritual connection.
strings.다행이네요. 그러면 초인을 만나러 가야 하는데…. 어디 있는 누구를 먼저: That's a relief. Then I need to meet an Champion... Who should I visit first, and where?
Try speaking to Mir. That child knows more about the outside world than I do.
strings.다른게 아니고, 이번 일이 끝나고 여유가 생기신다면 제 이야길 들어주시러: It's nothing urgent, but once this is over and you have some time, I hope you'll come hear my story.
strings.급한 일은 아니니까 혹시라도 기억나신다면 나중에 절 찾아와 말을 걸어주세: There's no hurry. If you remember, please come back and speak to me later.
I will, Harmonia. I'll be going, then. Take care.
strings.무슨 볼일이라도 남은 건가요? 육포라도 선물하러 오셨나요?: Did you still have something to do here? Or have you brought me some jerky?
strings.사실 그 육포…. 아니, 나중에 육포 잔뜩 사줄 테니 루맨에서 제일 가까: Actually, about that jerky... Never mind. I'll buy you lots of it later, so could you tell me where to find the Champion closest to Lumen?
strings.헛, 진짜요? 진짜? 거짓말 아니고 진짜?: Oh! Really? Really really? You aren't lying?
strings.진짜예요. 자, 약속. 육포 님의 이름을 걸고, 아니 여신님의 이름을 걸: Really. I promise. In the name of the mighty jerky—no, in the goddess's name! I, %s, promise Mir some jerky.
strings.와, 저 감동이에요. 이렇게 육포를 약속하시다니…. 제가 제대로 알려드릴: Wow, I'm so touched! To think you'd promise me jerky... I'll tell you everything you need to know. But why are you looking for an Champion?
strings.(초인을 찾아야 하는 이유를 미르에게 설명해준다.): (You explain to Mir why you need to find the Champions.)
strings.그러시구나. 여신님을 위한 일이니 기꺼이 알려드릴게요. 지스카드 님은 그: I see. If it's for the goddess, I'm happy to help. Lord Ziskad came back a moment ago, but he's already left again.
strings.그러면 환영의 대지에 계신 아드키나 님보다 더 가까운 곳에 있는 초인에게: Then you'll want an Champion closer than Atkina in the Land of Illusions, right?
strings.환영의 대지가 어딘지 모르겠지만, 거기보다 더 가까운 곳은 어디죠?: I don't know where the Land of Illusions is, but where can I find someone closer?
strings.쥬드 왕국 서쪽으로 쭉 가면 아말룬 사막이 있는데, 인근 지하에 도시 하: If you keep going west from the Kingdom of Jude, you'll reach the Amaloon Desert. There's a city underground nearby, called Tartaros. Its ruler is an Champion.
strings.사막을 쭉 지나가야 하는구나…. 어떤 사람인가요?: So I have to go all the way through the desert... What kind of person are they?
Let me tell you about Shynic, the King of the Underworld.
strings.명왕이면 죽음의 왕?: King of the Underworld? As in, king of death?
strings.맞아요. 오래전 대륙이 혼란스러웠을 때, 전장에서 엄청나게 많은 사람을: That's right. Long ago, when the continent was in turmoil, she sent an enormous number of people to their deaths on the battlefield.
strings.죗값을 받는 건지, 저주 때문인지 알 수 없지만 죽어도 죽지 않는 그런: I don't know whether it's punishment for her sins or a curse, but now she has a body that won't stay dead, even if she dies.
strings.언데드 아니고 사람이에요. 외모만 여자애지, 생각보다 복잡한 사람이거든요: She's human, not undead. She only looks like a young girl. She's a much more complicated person than you might think.
strings.그리고 심기를 불편하게 만들지 마세요. 잘못하면 그 자리에서 죽을지도 모: And don't upset her. One wrong move, and she might kill you on the spot...
strings.조심할게요. 고마워요. 루맨 연합 본부의 유란님 알죠? 유란님한테 육포에: I'll be careful. Thank you. You know Yuran at the Lumen Alliance Headquarters, right? I'll tell her about the jerky, so go ask her for some whenever you need it.
strings.진짜요? 와, 진짜 훌륭한 모험가님!! 진짜 맘에 들어요! 응원할테니까: Really? Wow, you're an amazing adventurer! I really like you! I'll be cheering you on, so have a good trip! I'm off to get some jerky!
strings.저렇게 좋아하니까 육포가 펫 음식이란 걸 굳이 말할 필요는 없겠지? 그럼: If it makes Mir that happy, I don't need to mention that the jerky is pet food, do I? Well, off to Tartaros.
It feels like you only just left.
strings.심심해…. 이러다 죽으면 멜빅이 내 묘비에 [심심해 죽은 샤이닉, 여기: I'm bored... If I die of this, will Melvic put 'Here lies Shynic, who died of boredom' on my gravestone?
strings.저기요. 재미있게 생겼다는 말은 무슨 뜻인가요?: Excuse me. What do you mean, I look fun?
strings.말 그대로야. 재미있게 생겼어. 꺄하!♡: Exactly what I said. You look fun. Ahaha! ♡
So what is it? Not many people speak to me directly. You must want something from me. Right?
I have a favor to ask...
A favor... I don't know what it is, but if it's fun, I'll do it.
strings.(샤이닉에게 부탁하려는 것에 대해 짧게 이야기한다.): (You briefly explain your request to Shynic.)
strings.흐음…. 그래서 내가 얻는 게 없는 것 같네? 지금은 아무것도 하기 싫으: Hmm... So there's nothing in it for me? I don't feel like doing anything right now. Go away.
strings.여기서 만약 보채거나 그런다면 어떻게 될까? 내 이야길 들었으니까 그만큼: What do you think would happen if you kept pestering me? You've heard about me, so I assume you're prepared for the consequences.
strings.여신의 심부름 같은 거 하지 말고, 타르타로스에서 적당히 쉬다 가는 건: Why don't you forget the goddess's errands and take a nice break here in Tartaros?
strings.여기는 내가 맘대로 만든 곳이라 내 기분을 상하게만 하지 않으면 모두 맘: I built this place however I pleased. As long as you don't upset me, you're free to use whatever you like.
strings.집사 멜빅에게 가면 숙소를 마련해줄 거야. 그러니 도시 구경이나 재미있게: My butler Melvic will arrange a place for you to stay. So go enjoy a look around the city.
strings.(어쩔 수 없군. 잠깐 기다려보는 수밖에….): (I don't have a choice. I'll have to wait a little...)
What are you doing? Aren't you leaving? If you don't, I'll take your head right...
A-all right. I'm going. I'll go, okay?
strings.그런데 저 녀석, 뭐지…? 표정이 이상하네. 저런 표정 기억을 살짝 잃은: What is it with that one, though...? That expression is strange. People who've lost a little of their memory used to look like that...
strings.아, 몰라. 귀찮아. 재미있는 것도 아닌데 뭐 이리 신경 쓰이는 거야?: Oh, whatever. Too much trouble. It's not even entertaining, so why does it keep bothering me?
An apparition of Lady Shynic arrived in such a hurry, I wondered what had happened.
strings.그렇지 않아도 모험가님께서 언제 타르타로스로 오실지 내심 궁금했는데 이렇: I'd been wondering when you might visit Tartaros, and now here you are. It's an honor.
strings.특유의 용맹함으로 정의로운 일들을 위해 싸우고 있으시다는 이야기를 들었습: I've heard that you fight for righteous causes with your characteristic bravery.
strings.그 모습이 망나니 같고, 게다가 여신의 일을 하신다고 해서 타르타로스에선: They say you fight like an executioner, and since you work for the goddess, people here in Tartaros call you the 'Goddess's Executioner.'
An executioner? And not just any executioner—the goddess's?
Sigh... I suppose it's not entirely wrong. Thank you for looking after me.
Judging by your expression, there's something you'd like to say.
You read me like a book! Indeed, I have a favor to ask.
strings.샤이닉 님께서 무슨 생각이신지 모르겠지만 요즘 들어 아무 일도 하지 않으: I don't know what Lady Shynic is thinking, but lately she hasn't done a thing. Normally, when something catches her interest, she pursues it without a moment's rest...
strings.제가 도시의 일 일부를 하고 있습니다만…. 경비나 관리 등 샤이닉 님이: I've been handling some of the city's affairs, but taking on all her duties, including security and administration, was too much. So I hired outside help.
strings.그런데 여기서 문제가 살짝 생겼습니다. 잠깐, 이야기를 이어가기 전에 부: But that has caused a small problem. Before I continue, could I ask you one favor?
strings.실례가 되지 않는다면 공사장을 어지럽히는 존재들을 쫓아내 주셨으면 합니다: If it wouldn't be too much trouble, could you drive away the creatures disrupting the construction site?
strings.워낙 급해서 일일이 설명해 드리지 못해 죄송합니다. 다녀오시면 다시 말씀: I'm sorry I can't explain everything right now. It's rather urgent. I'll tell you the rest when you return.
strings.왠지 망설이시는 것 같군요. 다녀오시는 동안 제가 샤이닉 님께 잘 말씀드: You seem hesitant. While you're away, I'll speak to Lady Shynic on your behalf, so that you can obtain what you came for.
strings.헛, 네!! 서둘러 다녀오겠습니다!!: Oh! Yes! I'll be back as quickly as I can!
Excellent work! You've taken quite a weight off my mind.
strings.안 그래도 샤이닉 님께 말씀드렸는데, 아직도 심기가 불편하신 것 같더군요: I did speak to Lady Shynic, but she still seems to be in a foul mood.
I see. I suppose I'll have to wait a little longer...
Then let me continue my explanation.
strings.저희와 계약한 길드는 경비로 유명한 [푸른 창 길드]입니다. 문제라 한: We hired the Blue Spear Guild, which is well known for its security work. The problem is that they haven't been doing their job properly.
strings.\"나락의 방\"에서 흘러나온 몬스터들과 도시가 방치됐다는 소문을 듣고: Monsters have escaped from the Abyss Chamber. Bandits heard that the city had been left unattended and came here. And...
strings.다른 계획이 있는 것 같은 푸른 창 길드의 길드원들이 뒤섞이는 바람에 공: Members of the Blue Spear Guild seem to have plans of their own. With all of them mixed together, the construction site has become utter chaos.
strings.아수라장을 먼저 정리해야겠군요. 그럼 다녀와도 될까요?: Then we'd better deal with that chaos first. Shall I get going?
Pardon? I haven't even asked you yet...
I'll be right back. You've helped me too, so I'll take care of it quickly.
Thank you, adventurer. You've dealt with one of Tartaros's greatest concerns...
strings.뭘요. 그나저나 샤이닉 님은 어떻던가요?: It's nothing. By the way, how is Lady Shynic?
strings.아직 별 답이 없으십니다. 어쩌죠?: She still hasn't given me an answer. What should we do?
strings.멜빅 씨가 열심히 해주셨는데, 어쩔 수 없죠. 저는 그냥 며칠 머물다 다: You've done your best, Melvic. It can't be helped. I'll stay a few days, then move on somewhere else.
strings.괜찮으시겠어요? 모험가님의 관심이 있을 만한 이야기가 초인기념관에 있을지: Are you sure? There may be something of interest to you at the Hall of Heroes...
strings.초인기념관은 샤이닉 님이 우리 도시의 랜드마크 같은 걸 만들어 보자 하셔: We built the Hall of Heroes because Lady Shynic wanted a landmark for our city.
strings.현존하는 7대 초인의 애장품부터 해서 과거의 초인들에 대한 이야기가 적혀: It contains treasured possessions of the seven living Champions, books recounting the lives of past Champions, and so on.
It's a small museum. There aren't many exhibits, but we do have a decent collection.
strings.그런 귀한 물건들을 어떻게 가져올 수 있었던 거죠? 적대적인 초인도 있을: How did you get such valuable things? Surely some of the Champions are hostile?
For the most part, she stole them.
If someone refused to hand something over, she would pick a fight and make use of her curse.
strings.설마 죽어도 죽지 않는 능력으로 질릴 때까지 반복한 건가요?: Don't tell me she kept coming back from the dead and doing it again until they got sick of her?
Yes, precisely. Ahahaha. That is exactly the sort of thing Lady Shynic would do.
strings.지금 초인기념관은 제가 들어갈 수 없는 공간이 됐습니다. 푸른 창 길드의: At present, I can't enter the Hall of Heroes. Randaine, master of the Blue Spear Guild, went inside and hasn't come out.
Hmm... The guild master who's plotting something...
strings.표정을 보니 초인기념관에 다녀오실 것 같군요. 이렇게 된 거 한 번만 더: Judging by your expression, you're thinking of visiting the memorial hall. In that case, let me ask for your help one more time.
strings.공사장 한 편에 푸른 창 길드의 선임 길드원인 루인이 있습니다. 그에게: Ruin, a senior member of the Blue Spear Guild, is at one side of the construction site. Ask him about the memorial hall and his guild master.
He should be able to tell you something useful.
strings.아, %s 님. 제가 따로 부탁할 일이 있는데, 괜찮으십니까?: Oh, %s. There's something else I'd like to ask of you, if you don't mind.
If you're interested, please come and speak to me later.
For now, you should look into the Hall of Heroes. That matter is urgent.
Yes, I'd better. I'll get going right away.
strings.누군가 했더니 너군. 저쪽에서 귀찮은 녀석들을 처리하고 있어서 알아봤더니: So it's you. I saw you dealing with those nuisances over there and asked around. You're the hero who saved the Kingdom of Jude?
I'm not really a hero... but if that's what people say, I suppose so.
strings.부인은 하지 않군. 여기 온 걸 보니 나한테 뭔가 원하고 있는 것 같은데: You're not denying it, then. Since you've come here, I assume there's something you want from me...
strings.초인기념관에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지 알려주시겠어요?: Could you tell me what's happening in the Hall of Heroes?
I wasn't planning to tell you that much...
Melvic said you would tell me.
strings.멜빅이 보내서 온 거라면 어쩔 수 없군. 내가 해결할 수 있는 수준이 아: If Melvic sent you, I suppose I have no choice. This has gone beyond anything I can handle.
strings.길드 마스터 란다인은 미쳤어. 길드를 크게 키우고 싶어 한 게 이렇게 될: Our guild master Randaine has gone mad. All he wanted was to make the guild stronger. I never imagined it would come to this...
strings.어떤 힘을 가지게 된 것 같은데…. 일반적인 힘이 아니었어. 인간이 결코: He seems to have gained some kind of power... but it isn't ordinary power. It's something no human should ever touch.
strings.그 힘을 사용하고 괴로워하고, 이상한 모습이었어. 그런 그를 말리기 위해: He would use it, then suffer for it. Something was terribly wrong. Many of our members tried to stop him, but... it was hopeless.
strings.타르타로스 초인기념관 안에서 벌어진 일이었는데, 샤이닉은 아무런 신경도: It happened inside the Hall of Heroes in Tartaros, but Shynic didn't care at all. As though she were waiting for someone else to deal with it.
strings.란다인의 힘을 보고 두려워한 길드원들은 그에게 충성을 다했고, 그렇지 않: The guild members who feared Randaine's power swore loyalty to him. Those who didn't were killed by him, crazed as he was with that power.
strings.그리고 초인기념관 안으로 들어갔지. 그곳을 아지트 삼아 타르타로스를 차지: Then he went into the memorial hall. He plans to use it as a base and seize Tartaros.
That kind of tremendous power does remind me of something...
strings.란다인은 분명 그 과정에 대해 괴로워하고 고민했어. 하지만, 지금은 고민: Randaine struggled and agonized over what was happening. But now he's a monster who doesn't even question it.
strings.부탁해. 너 같은 영웅이 여기 왔다는 건 우연이 아닐 테니까. 너라면 란: Please. A hero like you coming here can't be a coincidence. I think you can save Randaine, and Tartaros too.
strings.자꾸 영웅이라고 하니 좀 부끄럽네요. 그래도 한번 다녀와볼까요? 초인기념: You keep calling me a hero. It's a little embarrassing. Still, shall I take a look? I can visit the memorial hall while I'm at it...
You seem to be taking this lightly. Even so, you'd better be careful.
Thank you for your concern. I'll be right back.
Oh, there's something I wanted to ask. Hey! Hey! Gone already.
strings.(어둠 속에서 루인이 있던 곳을 바라보던 누군가의 인기척이 느껴진다.): (Ruin senses someone watching him from the shadows.)
strings.거기. 몰래 엿듣고 있는 너 말이야. 뭐하는 놈이지?: You there. The one eavesdropping. Who are you?
strings.(루인이 인기척이 있는 곳으로 다가가지만, 그곳엔 아무도 없다.): (Ruin approaches the place where he sensed someone, but no one is there.)
strings.어라, 내가 잘못 본 건가? 분명 여기 있던 거 같은데…. 아닌가? 란다: Huh? Did I imagine it? I'm sure someone was here... Wasn't there? I've had a lot on my mind because of Randaine. Maybe that's all it was. Sigh...
What's this, though...? Looks like someone dropped something...
You're back. Then Randaine must have been dealt with... That fool, Randaine...
strings.그나저나 이 물건에 대해 아는 게 있나?: By the way, do you know anything about these?
strings.(루인이 주머니에서 작은 돌들을 꺼내 보여준다.): (Ruin takes some small stones from his pocket and shows them to you.)
strings.헛, 이건!! 이거 어디서 구하셨죠?: Oh! These are...! Where did you find them?
strings.아까 저쪽에서 인기척이 느껴져서 가봤는데, 떨어진 주머니에 들어 있더라고: I sensed someone over there earlier and went to look. They were inside a pouch someone had dropped.
strings.그런데 이게 뭔데 그렇게 놀라?: What are they, anyway? Why are you so shocked?
strings.마석? 마력이라도 들어있는 돌인 건가?: Magic stones? Stones with magical power in them?
strings.맞아요. 그런 마석인데, 반과 마라가 만든 것과는 다른 종류 같아요. 마: That's right, but these seem different from the ones Ban and Mara made. Magic stones with no magic left in them...
I don't know who Ban and Mara are, but they sound like bad news, too.
These couldn't have ended up here by coincidence. What if...
I'll take care of the cleanup here. I don't know much about this, but...
Those magic stones... I found them near the Abyss Chamber.
The Abyss Chamber? Then I'd better go there.
strings.나락의 방으로 가려면 샤이닉의 허락이 필요하다. 그곳은 아무나 갈 수 있: You need Shynic's permission to enter the Abyss Chamber. It isn't a place just anyone can visit...
If you need permission just to enter, it must be incredibly dangerous.
strings.짐작한 그대로가 맞아. 심심한 걸 못 참는 샤이닉이 재미있는 장소로 만들: You guessed right. Shynic can't stand being bored, so she filled it with monsters to make it an entertaining place.
strings.그러다 악마들이 어디선가 나락의 방으로 흘러들어왔고, 그걸 재미있게 본: Then demons found their way into the chamber from somewhere. Shynic thought that was amusing and raised a magical barrier so that even they couldn't escape.
strings.그러고 안에 많은 금화와 보물들을 집어넣고 소문을 냈지. 나락의 방 안에: After that, she put piles of gold and treasure inside and spread the word: anyone who killed the demons in the chamber could keep whatever treasure they dropped.
strings.그렇게 많은 사람이 몰려들었지. 기괴하고, 불쾌하고, 추악한 어둠과 악마: And so people flocked there to face that bizarre, revolting, hideous darkness and its demons...
strings.많은 이들이 죽어갔지만, 샤이닉은 별 신경쓰지 않았지. 원래 그런 사람이: Many died, but Shynic paid little attention. Stranger still, everyone just shrugged it off, saying she'd always been like that...
That sounds terrible. How could anyone...
strings.그런데 말이야. 그 중에서 가장 강한 말파스가 어떤 인간 마법사의 망령을: But then Malphas, the strongest of the demons, apparently revived the ghost of a human mage. After that, Shynic began acting strangely.
strings.나락의 방에 가는 모험가들을 모두 돌려보내고, 아무도 들어가지 못하게 했: She turned away all the adventurers heading for the Abyss Chamber and forbade anyone from entering.
strings.금화와 보물들을 가져가고자 했던 많은 모험가들이 그 이유를 물어도 대답해: Many adventurers hoping to claim the gold and treasure asked why, but she wouldn't answer.
strings.대체 무슨 생각인지 모르겠단 말이야. 그래서 란다인 녀석도 이상한 힘으로: I have no idea what she's thinking. That's why Randaine tried to take over this place with that strange power of his...
I've been to all sorts of places, but I don't think I've ever seen a city with such complicated problems.
And its ruler, Lady Shynic, has quite an unusual personality...
strings.먼저 샤이닉에게 가서 사실을 이야기하고 허락을 받고 들어가는 게 좋을 것: I think you should tell Shynic what happened and get her permission before you go inside.
strings.난 이제 남은 길드원들과 함께 무슨 일을 할지 고민해봐야겠어. 그게 내가: As for me, I'll have to think about what to do with the remaining guild members. That seems to be my responsibility now. Anyway, thanks for helping.
It's nothing. I'll be going now.
strings.어, 그래. 벌써 갔군. 급하다고 해야 하나, 추진력이 빠르다고 해야 하: Yeah, all right. Gone already. Is that impatience, or decisiveness?
strings.그나저나 저 녀석…. 강한 힘을 어떻게 써야 하는지 잘 알고 있는 것 같: Still, that one... seems to understand how to use great power properly. Impressive... Unlike that fool Randaine...
You look as though you've been waiting for me.
strings.나락의 방에 갈 생각이야? 가도 상관없긴 하지만…. 굳이 가야겠어?: Thinking of going to the Abyss Chamber? I don't mind if you do, but... must you really go?
strings.숨기고 있는게 있다면 말해 줄래요?: If you're hiding something, would you tell me?
strings.이곳에서 당신이 하지 못할 일은 없는데, 아무것도 하지 않는다면 이유가: There's nothing here you couldn't do. If you're doing nothing, you must have a reason. There could be serious danger ahead. Is it really all right to just sit here?
strings.내가 있는데, 무슨 위험이 생긴다는 거야?: What danger could there be with me around?
Could you take a look at this? Randaine had it.
strings.(샤이닉에게 마력이 없는 마석을 보여준다.): (You show Shynic the magic stone with no magic left in it.)
strings.어, 특이한 마석이네? 어디 볼까? 데이모스 교단의 것이네. 어? 그런데: Oh, an unusual magic stone. Let me see... It's from the Deimos cult. Huh? But it was made using an Agasura spell formula...
strings.혹시 반과 마라가 데이모스 교단하고 손을 잡았나…?: Could Ban and Mara have joined forces with the Deimos cult...?
strings.그 가짜 아가슈라 일족 얘기군. 그 가짜들은 어차피 진짜와 가짜도 구분도: You mean that clan of fake Agasuras. Those fakes can't even tell the genuine article from a counterfeit. Don't worry about them.
strings.진짜는 뭐고, 가짜 아가슈라는 무슨 이야기죠?: What do you mean, genuine and fake Agasuras?
Explaining that sounds like a bother...
strings.후우…. 아가슈라 일족은 악을 저지르지 않으면 안 되는 자들이란 건 알고: Sigh... You know the Agasuras are beings who have no choice but to commit evil, right? What if they're targeting Tartaros?
strings.그들의 최종 목표가 여신일지도 모르기 때문에 저는 나락의 방에 들어가야겠: Their ultimate target might be the goddess. That's why I have to enter the Abyss Chamber.
strings.샤이닉 님이 아무것도 하지 않는다고 해서 끝나는 게 아니에요. 누군가는: Doing nothing won't make this go away, Lady Shynic. Someone has to act.
strings.굳이 가겠다면 말리진 않겠어. 과연 살아 돌아올 수 있을까?: If you're that determined, I won't stop you. I wonder if you'll make it back alive.
Everyone says that, but I've always come back alive.
strings.드디어 심심한 상태에서 벗어났군요. 뭐, 전 저를 믿고, 저를 믿는 사람: At last, you're no longer bored. Well, I simply believe in myself, and in the people who believe in me.
strings.그래? 그럼 가서 나락의 방을 아지트로 삼으려는 악마 말파스를 손보고 와: Is that so? Then go deal with Malphas, the demon trying to make the Abyss Chamber his base.
strings.차원의 틈을 통해서 나락의 방에 들어온 걸 내가 잡아다 가뒀는데, 모험가: He entered the chamber through a dimensional rift, so I caught him and locked him in. But he kept growing stronger by absorbing adventurers' souls.
He swore he'd get revenge on me. I wonder how strong he's become.
Is that everything? I don't think it is...
Then tell me later. I'll take that as permission and be on my way.
strings.(샤이닉이 나락의 방으로 향하는 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라보고 있다.): (Shynic stares intently at %s's back as they head for the Abyss Chamber.)
strings.그분은 출발하셨군요. 저기, 샤이닉 님…?: Our guest has left, then. Um, Lady Shynic...?
Shouldn't we stop them? The Abyss Chamber is currently...
strings.후우. 다른 건 다 해도 그를 다시 손보는 건 하지 못하겠어. 신이라도: Sigh. I can do anything else, but I can't face him again. Perhaps I could if I were a god. That's why everyone wants to become one.
strings.아무리 힘이 있다 한들 껍데기뿐인 인간은 여기까지니까. 봐, 내가 그렇잖: No matter how much power you have, a human who's nothing but an empty shell can only get so far. Look at me. Look how helpless I am.
strings.인간, 그것도 한 명이 여기까지 오다니…. 비록 내가 나락의 방에 갇혀있: A human—and only one—has made it this far... Even trapped here in the Abyss Chamber, I've never had anyone reach me.
strings.너는 다른 인간들과 좀 격이 다른 것 같군. 가지고 있는 힘 자체의 구성: You seem to be on a different level from other humans. The very composition of your power is unlike theirs.
strings.그 영감탱이가 인간 하나 막지 못할 정도로 나약했다니 정말 몰랐어. 내가: I had no idea that old fool was too weak to stop a single human. What a waste of effort waking him was.
I thought he'd be able to deal with Shynic.
strings.영감탱이? 그 망령으로 나타난 마법사? 샤이닉은 왜?: Old fool? The mage who appeared as a ghost? What's he got to do with Shynic?
You want to know? Then you'll have to defeat me.
strings.그러면 내가 널 쓰러뜨리면 제대로 물어볼 수 있다는 거지?: So if I defeat you, you'll answer my questions properly?
strings.이길 수만 있다면 말이야. 약속하지. 난 럭스 같은 다른 악마와 달라서: If you can win. I promise. Unlike Lux and the other demons, I keep my word.
strings.일단 그 약속을 하기 전에 한 가지 제안을 하지. 네가 가진 힘, 나를: But before we settle that promise, I have a proposal. Why not put your power to work for me?
strings.보아하니 누군가의 심부름밖에 하지 못할 운명인 것 같은데…. 그럴 바에야: You look doomed to spend your life running errands for someone else... If that's all you have to look forward to, why not serve me?
strings.이 위대한 말파스 님께서 나락의 방으로 들어오는 인간의 영혼들을 선물로: I, the great Malphas, will give you the souls of the humans who enter the Abyss Chamber.
The more souls you devour, the stronger you'll become, until you can laugh at Lux. I've already made the chamber work that way. What do you say?
I'm offering you the honor of becoming a great human. Think carefully.
strings.후후. 멍청한 까마귀군. 내가 악마가 하는 말을 그대로 받아들일 거라 생: Heh. What a stupid crow. Do you really think I'd take a demon's words at face value?
strings.거절한다. 인간이고 악마고 모두 힘에 집착하는 멍청한 짓을 하네. 물론: I refuse. Humans, demons—everyone keeps doing stupid things out of an obsession with power. Of course power is useful, but this isn't the way!
strings.힘은 좋은 거야. 왜 좋지 않다고 생각하는 거지? 그러면 지금 네가 가지: Power is good. Why would you think otherwise? What about the power you possess right now?
strings.솔직해져라. 힘을 가지고 있다면 더 위를 원하고, 아래에 있는 존재를 지: Be honest with yourself. Once you have power, you seek greater heights and rule over those beneath you.
strings.자, 다시 한 번 더 묻겠다. 내 밑으로 들어올 생각 없나?: Now, I'll ask you one more time. Will you serve me?
strings.또 한 번 말하지만, 거절한다! 나는 널 쓰러뜨리고 내가 알고 싶은 걸: And I'll say it again: I refuse! I'll defeat you and find out what I want to know!
What a spirited rejection of my offer. Heh.
strings.좋아, 네가 날 이긴다면 네 질문에 대답해주지. 하지만, 네가 내 이야길: Very well. If you defeat me, I'll answer your questions. But you'll never live to hear my tale.
I will devour your soul right here. That is your fate. That is the truth of this world.
strings.…그럼 어디 한 번 해볼까?: ...Then shall we put that to the test?
strings.자, 덤벼라. 힘의 존재 이유조차 받아들이지 못하는 어리석은 인간이여!!: Come at me, foolish human! You cannot even accept why power exists!
strings.믿을 수 없다…. 내가 이렇게 쓰러질 줄이야. 이게 인간을 얕본 대가라니: Impossible... To think I would fall like this. The price of underestimating a human...
strings.저기 악마님. 정신 차려요. 내가 물어볼 게 있는데, 대답해줄 건가요?: Hello, Mr. Demon? Stay with me. I have questions. Are you going to answer them? Mr. Demon? Hello?
I have lost. I'll answer your questions properly. A promise is a promise.
strings.패배를 인정하다니 놀라운데…. '악'을 자처하는 존재 중에 이런 경우는: I'm surprised you'd admit defeat... It's rare to see that from someone who calls himself evil. Interesting. Take a look at this.
Do you know anything about this magic stone? It was found at the entrance to the Abyss Chamber.
A Deimos cult magic stone bearing an Agasura spell formula... An interesting object. You say it was lying outside the Abyss Chamber?
strings.난 샤이닉이 건 속박의 저주 때문에 나락의 방에서 한 발자국도 밖으로 나: Shynic's binding curse prevents me from taking even one step outside the chamber. How interesting that this was found right out front.
strings.아가슈라 그놈들이 뭔가 꾸미고 있는 게 확실한가 보네. 악마도 아닌데 열: Those Agasuras must be plotting something. They aren't even demons, yet they're always hard at work doing evil. Beyond that, I know nothing.
strings.알았어. 그건 그렇고 그 망령으로 나타난 마법사는 누구야?: All right. Then who was the mage who appeared as a ghost?
strings.오래전 이스트랜드의 암흑 전쟁에서 쥬드왕국을 지킨 영웅적 마법사 익시온을: You don't know Ixion, the heroic mage who defended the Kingdom of Jude during Eastland's Dark War long ago?
strings.나야 외부 사람이니 알 리가 없지. 어디서 들어본 것 같긴 해. 아, 루: I'm not from around here. How would I know? Though the name does sound familiar... Oh, I heard it in Lumen.
strings.익시온은 왕국을 데이모스 교단에서 지키기 위해 무슨 짓이든 했던 인간이지: Ixion was a human who would do anything to protect his kingdom from the Deimos cult. Even to a demon like me, he was mad. Heh heh...
strings.자신의 명예를 드높이는 일이라 생각했고, 결국 데이모스 교단에서나 할 법: He thought it would bring him glory. In the end, he chose to do something worthy of the Deimos cult itself.
strings.어린아이들에게 강제적으로 마력을 주입하고, 어둠의 '속박'으로 전장에 나: He forcibly infused young children with magic and used dark 'bindings' to send them onto the battlefield. Weapons, nothing more...
strings.벗어날 수 없는 저주라고 해야 하나…. 데이모스 교단에서도 그 속박을 주: You might call it an inescapable curse... Even the Deimos cult took an interest in it.
Many people died, and their souls fell into the hands of demons. I gathered plenty of souls myself. For that, I am grateful to Ixion.
strings.그런 마법사를 영웅으로 모시고 있다고? 쥬드 왕국은 그 사실을 알고 있는: And they honor a mage like that as a hero? Does the Kingdom of Jude know what he did?
They probably don't know that much. Humans are foolish. Even if they knew, they'd cover it up. You have a demon's word on that.
strings.닥쳐. 그래서 그 아이들은 어떻게 됐지?: Shut up. What happened to the children?
strings.궁금하긴 하나 보네. 그럼 이야기해 주지. 익시온이 강제로 주입한 마력은: Curious, are you? Then I'll tell you. The magic Ixion forced into them drove them berserk and eventually killed them.
strings.전쟁이 끝나고 스스로 죽지 않은 아이들은 익시온의 손에 죽었어. 더 이상: When the war ended, Ixion killed the children who hadn't already died from it. They were no longer useful. That was their fate...
But one child survived. A child who cherished a red ribbon above all else...
strings.그 아이가 살아남은 건 별 거 없었어. 운이 좋은 건지, 나쁜 건지 저주: There was no grand reason for her survival. Good luck or bad, a curse simply made her unable to die. That child was...
Shh. That's enough. I don't need to hear any more.
strings.그런가? 그럼 대화를 마무리할까?: Is that so? Then shall we bring this conversation to an end?
It was a pleasure, human who defeated me... Farewell.
strings.(말파스가 조소를 지으며 스스로 소멸을 선택한다.): (With a mocking smile, Malphas chooses to destroy himself.)
strings.(말파스가 흔적도 없이 그 자리에서 사라졌다. 제대로 소멸했는지 악한 기: (Malphas vanishes without a trace. Not a hint of evil remains; he seems to have been truly destroyed.)
strings.이제 끝난 건가…? 아, 이런 말은 하는 게 아니지. 보통 이런 말 하면: Is it over now...? Ah, I shouldn't say that. Things usually come back when someone says that...
Whew. Time to go. I have plenty of questions for Shynic.
You're back. Malphas may be a foolish demon, but he couldn't have been easy to defeat...
strings.그래서 알고 싶은 건 알아냈어?: So, did you find out what you wanted?
strings.아뇨. 그 악마도 마석이 데이모스 교단의 것이면서 아가슈라의 술식으로 만: No. All the demon knew was that the stone belonged to the Deimos cult and was made with an Agasura spell formula. I learned nothing else.
strings.아하하하하하. 넌 진짜 재미있는 인간이야. 재미있게 생긴 인간이기도 하고: Ahahahaha! You're such an entertaining human. And an entertaining-looking one, too. ♡ Isn't that right, Goddess's Executioner?
strings.망나니든 심부름꾼이든 뭐 어때? 내가 보답으로 네가 원하는 걸 주면 되는: Executioner, errand-runner—what does it matter? All I need to do is reward you with what you wanted, right?
Glad we're on the same page.
strings.그럼 가까이 와 볼래? 어디 보자. 머리가 예쁘네. 내가 머리에 손을 올: Then come a little closer. Let's see. What a lovely head. May I put my hand on it?
If I say no, you'll do something terrifying, won't you?
strings.빙고! 맞아, 어떻게 알았어? 후후♡: Bingo! Exactly. How did you know? Hehe. ♡
strings.(샤이닉이 %s의 머리에 손을 올려놓는다. 샤이닉의 손끝에서 검고 붉은: (Shynic rests her hand on %s's head. Black and red light swirls around her fingertips, then gathers into a single whirling glow.)
Anticlimactic, isn't it? You'd expect passing on power to be complicated, but it's surprisingly dull. It was like that back then, too... Ah, pretend you didn't hear that.
That should help the novice goddess.
I don't really feel a dramatic difference.
strings.나도 잘 몰라. 나중에 그 힘이 어떻게 될 진 아무도 모르잖아. 안 그래: I'm not sure either. No one knows what that power will become later. Right?
strings.날 이렇게 이용만 하고 그냥 가버리게? 왜 그래? 섭섭하게♡: You're just going to use me and leave? How could you? I'm hurt. ♡
strings.저기요. 샤이닉 님…. 지금 멘트 말이에요. 오해 소지가 가득한 거 알아: Um, Lady Shynic... You do realize how easily someone could get the wrong idea from what you just said?
It's because I want to use you for something entertaining.
strings.재미있는 거요? 위험한거 아니죠?: Entertaining? It won't be dangerous, will it?
strings.지금은 비밀이야. 그럼 조금만 기다려. 알았지? 만나게 해주고 싶은 분이: That's a secret for now. Wait a little while, all right? There's someone I want you to meet.
strings.그리고 그 전에 자기 꼬리를 물고 있는 뱀한테 죽지 않게 조심하고♡ 그: And in the meantime, be careful not to get yourself killed by the snake biting its own tail. ♡ That snake likes swallowing people like you.
strings.그럼 멜빅에게 가 봐. 내가 부르기 전까지는 절대 나한테 오지 마. 맘이: Now go see Melvic. Don't come back until I call for you. If I change my mind, who knows what I'll do? Hehe. Get a few days of good rest.
strings.후우, 일단 가보자. 그런데 꼬리를 무는 뱀은 또 뭐야?: Sigh. I'd better go. But what's this snake biting its tail supposed to mean?
strings.(샤이닉이 %s의 뒷모습이 사라질 때까지 빤히 바라본다.): (Shynic watches %s intently until they disappear from view.)
strings.(샤이닉이 있는 뒤쪽 어두운 골목에서 남성으로 보이는 검은 그림자가 나타: (A dark, seemingly male silhouette appears in the shadowy alley behind Shynic.)
strings.(샤이닉이 살며시 조소를 머금고 골목 안으로 걸어간다.): (With a faint mocking smile, Shynic walks into the alley.)
What a foul stench of beast.
strings.나야말로 고마워. 뭐, 전부 네 계획 위에서 저 녀석이 움직여준 것뿐이지: I should be thanking you. Though all that happened was that our little friend followed the course you'd planned.
strings.약속대로 이 일이 '모두' 끝나면 네 소원을 들어주겠다. 시간이 얼마 남: As promised, when all of this is over, I will grant your wish. There isn't much time left, so please wait a little longer. I ask this of you.
strings.처리할 일이 많은가 보네. 과연 네가 할 수 있을지 궁금하군. 신이란 존: Sounds like you've got plenty to take care of. I wonder if you can really do it. Can a dying man accomplish what even a god couldn't...?
Now that I think of it, I'm jealous. Of the fact that you're dying...
What an odd thing to envy.
strings.됐고, 이제 당분간 내 도시에 나타나지 않았으면 좋겠어. 다시 나타난다는: Enough of that. I'd rather you stayed out of my city for a while. If you appear here again, it will mean things haven't ended as they should.
Kazno Nas, leader of the Agasura clan.
strings.(샤이닉이 데스사이드를 들어 어둠 속을 향해 겨눈다.): (Shynic raises her Death Scythe and points it into the darkness.)
strings.(점차 어둠이 조금씩 사라지고, 드레드락 풍의 헤어 스타일을 지닌 한 청: (The shadows gradually fade, revealing a young man with dreadlocks.)
As willful as ever, King of the Underworld.
If that time comes, I'll kill you myself. Well, at least I won't be bored.
strings.(카즈노가 손가락으로 샤이닉의 데스사이드를 살짝 밀어낸다.): (Kazno gently pushes Shynic's Death Scythe aside with a finger.)
strings.내가 너에게 죽는 일은 없을 거야. 나는 이 세계를 위해서도, 옛 친구를: I won't die at your hands. I still have much to do for this world, and for an old friend.
It seems you've finished speaking with Lady Shynic.
She told me to take a few days off and rest.
Understood. You really are remarkable, adventurer.
Changing Lady Shynic's mind is no easy feat...
And thank you for keeping it a secret.
No. I merely thought there must be something.
strings.말파스를 소멸시키는 거로 충분했으니까요. 어, 그런데 샤이닉 님이 인사시: Destroying Malphas was enough. Oh, by the way, who is the person Lady Shynic wants me to meet?
strings.그것까진 잘 모르겠습니다. 샤이닉 님께서 알아서 하시겠죠. 저는 그저 평: That, I don't know. I'm sure Lady Shynic will see to it. I am merely an ordinary butler, after all. Hehe.
strings.(아무리 봐도 평범한 사람은 아닌 것 같다니까.): (No matter how I look at it, he isn't ordinary at all.)
strings.그러면 샤이닉 님이 다시 부르실 때까지 제가 준비한 숙소에서 푹 쉬셨으면: Please rest well in the accommodation I've prepared until Lady Shynic calls for you again. If you need anything or find anything uncomfortable, let me know at once.
Since Lady Shynic has acknowledged you, I shall treat you as our most honored guest.
strings.아, %s 님. 제가 따로 부탁할 일이 또 생겼는데, 괜찮으십니까? 해도: Oh, %s. Another matter has come up that I'd like to ask you about. Would that be all right? It's a small thing, entirely optional.
I'll explain it to you in detail later.
All right. Thank you. I could use some rest now.
strings.(후우…. 이제 또 무슨 일이 일어날지 감도 안 잡혀. 그나저나 이리스는: (Whew... I have no idea what might happen next. I wonder how Iris is doing.)
I'm doing well. Please don't worry.
strings.(갑자기 %s의 시야에 이리스의 모습이 희미하게 나타난다.): (Iris's faint image suddenly appears in %s's field of vision.)
strings.이리스? 설마, 이리스? 이리스는 루맨에 있잖아?: Iris? Is that really you? But you're in Lumen, aren't you?
Yes, it's me. I've been continuing my training in the Training Forest.
strings.그런데 어떻게 내 앞에 나타난 거야?: Then how did you appear in front of me?
strings.뭐라고 설명해야 할까…. 분명 제 모습이긴 한데, %s에게만 보이는 홀로: How should I explain it...? It is my image, but it's something like a hologram that only %s can see.
strings.처음 시도하는 건데 어떤가요?: This is my first time trying it. What do you think?
strings.마치 절 마력 통신기처럼 인식하고 말씀하시네요?: You're talking as though I'm a magical communicator.
Ahahaha. I was so surprised, it just slipped out...
strings.괜찮아요. 저도 갑자기 등장했는 걸요. 그냥 대화를 나누고 싶다는 생각을: It's all right. I did appear without warning. I simply thought about wanting to talk to you, and then we connected like this. It surprised me a little, too.
I think this happened because I received Lady Shynic's power.
So a Champion's power really does help. That's a relief.
strings.하지만, 아직 안정화가 되지 않아서 오래 유지하는 건 힘들 것 같…………: But it hasn't stabilized yet, so I don't think I can keep this up for very lo—
strings.(이리스의 모습이 굳어서 움직이지 않는다. 그러다 시야에서 흐려져 사라진: (Iris's image freezes in place, then fades from view.)
strings.살짝 어설프긴 해도 신기하네. 초인 한 명의 힘을 받은 것 뿐인데, 이런: It's still a bit rough, but that's amazing. The power of just one Champion has already made this possible.
I don't know if you can hear me... but hang in there, Iris. I'll keep doing my best, too.
